scenes.title: Local Bench
scenes.caption: Benchmark the models you actually run.
scenes.narration: This is Local Bench, from Companion Intelligence.

scenes.caption: One page. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
scenes.narration: One page. It counts the curated catalog, what you have installed, and your fastest run.

shots.alt: Local Bench dashboard: hero copy and four summary cards for catalog size, installed models, top intelligence score and fastest measured model.

scenes.caption: Forty-two curated models. Ollama serves them.
scenes.narration: Local Bench talks to Ollama. With no daemon running, it shows the catalog and says so.

shots.alt: The model picker: curated Ollama models as selectable cards, the installed and curated counts, and the notice that Ollama is not reachable.

scenes.caption: Pick a prompt. Edit it. That exact text runs.
scenes.narration: Pick a prompt. The box below it is editable, and that exact text is what runs.

shots.alt: The test prompt dropdown, its category and description, and the editable textarea holding the prompt that will be sent to the model.

scenes.caption: Fourteen prompts, grouped by the work they test.
scenes.narration: Fourteen prompts: coding, reasoning, analysis, creative, operations. Expand one to read it first.

shots.alt: The prompt library grid with the first card expanded to reveal the full prompt text that will be sent to the model.

scenes.caption: Select what you have installed, then run.
scenes.narration: Select what you have installed and run it. Models you have not pulled stay disabled.

shots.alt: The run controls — Run benchmark, Select all installed, Clear selection — sitting under the prompt library, above the progress meter.

scenes.caption: Ranked by intelligence index, before you download.
scenes.narration: Every catalog model, ranked by the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, with size and context window.

shots.alt: The Model intelligence table: catalog models ranked by intelligence index, each with a bar, its size, context window and input types.

scenes.caption: The docs ship inside the app.
scenes.narration: The docs ship inside the app: what the numbers mean, how to budget agents.

shots.alt: The in-app documentation view: topic sidebar on the left, the Local Bench overview topic on the right.

scenes.title: Local Bench
scenes.caption: Measured on your hardware, stored on your disk.
scenes.narration: Forty-two curated models, fourteen prompts, results kept in a local SQLite file.
Local Bench. Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
